text.brief: In 1906 the University of Illinois president Edmund James wrote to Theodore Roosevelt that the nation educating China's young would reap the largest return in moral, intellectual and commercial influence.
text.record: Congress authorized the return of about $11 million of the American Boxer indemnity in May 1908, and the Qing court agreed to spend it on students bound for the United States. The first scholars sailed in 1909, and the preparatory school that opened in Beijing in 1911 became Tsinghua. Hu Shih, Chao Yuen Ren and Qian Xuesen all studied in America on the indemnity.
text.reading: The United States ran the Attract stage on purpose and on a thirty-year horizon, and the program returned scientists and diplomats. The same program produced Qian Xuesen, whom the United States later expelled, a reminder that a pipeline pays only while the host keeps faith with the people it draws.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. A long-horizon program depends on keeping faith with those it draws, and the United States broke faith with Qian in 1950.
text.fix: Fund talent programs on a horizon longer than an election, and pair them with rules that keep faith with the people they draw.
